top_replies.author: ivanciraj
top_replies.snippet: Such is life

leaderboard.style: tagged FAQ explainer; recaps the parent in 1-3 sentences; sub-2min on Elon, hours-later on everyone else
fan image + one-liner praise; posts within 40s-2m of Elon Grok-Bot tweets
launch-thread data dumps on own Jev post; not a cross-thread hunter except as OP

patterns: Launch posts (Jev, ValsAI): author self-replies posted at +0-2s take the like board; community replies rarely crack the top 5.
Meme/image-only replies are the like-max format outside author threads (rongalichay 1371, RoteeWolf 1146, gofish99983 1226).
Winning community text is a one-liner joke or fandom riff (Technoblade, Turing-test despair, 'such is life'), 5-20 words, 2-5h after parent once quote-tweets amplify.
OpenAI ship posts (sama, Tibo): usage-complaint paragraphs at +5-20m and #keep4o hashtag brigades at +1-3h outrank hype; Tibo himself replies +9h.
Elon AI posts: like mass is tiny vs reply volume; @grok and fan accounts occupy the first 2 minutes; no 1k-like reply exists.
Genuine expertise is rare in the like ranking: andrebckr usage-math on Tibo, taggart_maher correcting Polymarket's Jev framing, rohanpaul_ai latency take (658, 6th on Jev).
Timing windows: 0-40s bot/fan sniping on Elon; 0-20m complaint/meme on OpenAI ships; 2-5h joke-after-viral on eval clips; 4-10h named-dev replies (thdxr, ThePrimeagen, shadcn) on Jev.
Length: top-liked community replies are short; long posts only score when they are usage complaints (Tibo) or OP technical thread.
Verbatim-quote-of-the-post is almost absent; contrarian takes show up as quote-tweets (NathanFlurry on Jev) more than as replies.
